svg.aria-label: Cutting chai, 11 p.m. One question on a napkin: what would make a recruiter stop scrolling? The napkin turned into a paper desk. The desk wanted a window. The window wanted a sky. The sky refused to stay sunny and turned itself into night. By chai number four, a paper version of me had climbed onto the desk, fixed his glasses and started waving. He hasn't stopped since. I told him to calm down. He got a hot-air balloon instead. Somewhere along the way the napkin became a website. The chai went cold. Worth it.

svg.text: Cutting chai, 11 p.m. One question on a napkin:
what would make a recruiter stop scrolling?
The napkin turned into a paper desk. The desk wanted a window. The window
wanted a sky. The sky refused to stay sunny and turned itself into night.
By chai number four, a paper version of me had climbed onto the desk, fixed his
glasses and started waving. He hasn't stopped since.
I told him to calm down. He got a hot-air balloon instead.
Somewhere along the way the napkin became a website. The chai went cold.
